steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
args: set -e; mkdir -p /workspace/pdf-artifacts; docker run --name pdf-service-verify --memory=1g --cpus=1 --network=none --entrypoint=node pdf-service:verify scripts/smoke.cjs || { docker inspect --format 'PDF_CONTAINER_OOM={{.State.OOMKilled}}' pdf-service-verify; exit 1; }; docker cp pdf-service-verify:/tmp/pdf-service-artifacts/. /workspace/pdf-artifacts/; docker rm pdf-service-verify
